note: The documentation registry, in two tables. `documents` describes what each file under docs/ is, on four axes. `subject`: what it covers. `status`: `living` claims current truth and is wrong when stale, `record` preserves a moment and is wrong when rewritten, `measured` carries dated observations and is corrected by re-probing rather than by rewriting (the third value was added 2026-08-05, when five rows were found describing that genre in prose while their status said living). `reach`: how a reader gets to the file, DERIVED from the repo by tools/build/docs-reach.mjs and gated against this declaration, never hand-set. Strongest channel first: `injected` arrives in every session's context unasked, `skill` is named by a skill so invoking it pulls the doc, `app` is named in lib/ or pages/ CODE so a page reads or opens it (a mention in a comment does not count and is stripped), `orphan` means no automated channel puts it in front of anyone not already browsing docs/. `maintenance`: the discipline that keeps it true, and where none exists the row says so plainly rather than saying 'authored' (a bare row is barred by test, since the census gate otherwise invites filling rows instead of thinking about them). `claims` records statements that live in more than one place, since repetition is the only condition under which drift exists: each row names the one authoritative carrier and every repetition, with its relation (`copy` byte-comparable, `paraphrase` restated, `pointer` no content of its own, `live read` fetched at use), who keeps a copy (`kept`: by hand, or by a named builder), and the check that holds it or the reason none does. A row with `applies_to` is a family rule: the repetition policy for a class of claims that drift individually. The registry is authoritative for what it covers and owes the repo no inventory of claims; the documents census, by contrast, is complete by construction (tools/test/docs-registry.test.mjs holds every .md/.json under docs/ to exactly one row). Rendered by show-repo's Map view, Docs tab. Genre precedents: budget-drs DOCS.md (three genres, three rules) and properties.csv (one authoritative carrier, gated copies, unchecked declared honestly).
